feature_summary: US-006.4: Visual level selection UI with locked/unlocked/completed states. ProgressBar component (75 lines), LevelButton refactored (+51 net), index.tsx with unlock status loading and event-driven refresh. 22 unit tests passing (20 LevelButton + 2 ProgressBar helpers), coverage 100% ProgressBar, 90.9% LevelButton, 74.28% index.tsx.

key_strengths: Excellent component design (ProgressBar reusable, single responsibility)
Accessibility-first design (ARIA labels, semantic roles, touch targets 44px+)
Loading states prevent layout shift (clean UX)
Tamagui mastery (theme tokens, animations, responsive design)
Helper function getPreviousLevelName() is pure and testable
Proper async/await in useEffect with error handling
medium_issues: Use YStack instead of Stack in ProgressBar (cosmetic, non-breaking)
Duplicate refresh logic in index.tsx (DRY principle violation)
Inconsistent percentage rounding in LevelButton (calculated twice)
low_issues: Magic heights (66px vs 80px) need documentation comment
Duplicate backgroundColor ternary (same value both branches)
Async function not awaited in event callback (intentional fire-and-forget)

index_coverage.note: Acceptable for integration complexity (async loading, event listeners)

visual_states: Locked: lock icon, opacity 0.4, unlock message, disabled
Unlocked: progress bar, X/Y mots (Z%), clickable
Completed: checkmark icon, 100% progress, green color, selectable
technical_implementation.data_loading: Async mount with loading spinner, Map<Level, LevelProgress> for O(1) lookups
